issues.description: The problem specification and tests expect construct_zero_state_prep_circuit to return a stim.Circuit, but the template's function is annotated to return None. The solution implements and returns a stim.Circuit. The mismatch in the template's return type annotation (-> None) and its docstring (which says it returns a stim.Circuit) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students and cause type-aware tooling or tests to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template function signature to match the specification and solution by changing the return annotation to -> stim.Circuit and ensuring the function returns the constructed stim.Circuit (or an appropriate placeholder that students will replace). Also update the docstring/inline comment to be consistent with the signature.
